versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: And thence I went to another place in the desert, and approached to the east of this mountain range.
verses.text_fa: از آنجا به مکان دیگری در بیابان رفتم و به سمت شرقی این رشته‌کوه نزدیک شدم.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto u pustinji i približih se istočnoj strani toga gorskog lanca.

verses.text_en: And 〚there〛 I saw =aromatic= trees exhaling the fragrance of frankincense and myrrh, and the trees also were similar to the almond tree.
verses.text_fa: و 〚در آنجا〛 درختان =خوشبویی= دیدم که عطر کندر و مُرّ از آنها برمی‌خاست؛ و آن درختان به درخت بادام نیز شباهت داشتند.
verses.text_hr: Ondje 〚vidjeh〛 =mirisna= stabla koja su širila miris tamjana i smirne; stabla bijahu nalik i bademu.
